title: 第13章 偷鸡不成蚀把米第14章 太子遇袭的内幕
slug: 暮年太子每天增加一点精神
content_zh:
魏贤仁并非夏无恙的第一个掌印太监，而是在他失势以后，经过各方博弈，被安排到他这里的掌印太监。
贪婪、狭隘、自私自利、天赋一般……几乎没有多少可取之处，这些年一直欺负他这个老太子，甚至连夏皇赐予的奇宝都敢谋夺。
把这么一个人安排在东宫做掌印太监，可见各方势力之默契，摆明了不想让夏无恙好过。
被废以后，夏无恙为了能够恢复修炼根基，重新踏上修炼之路，也做了一些过分的事情。
魏贤仁将这些事情收集起来，用来威胁夏无恙，不但逼迫他交出东宫大权，甚至连很多资源和宝物都要交给魏贤仁。
借助东宫的资源和宝物，魏贤仁才能够在短短几十年里连破桎梏，晋升中三品，如今已经是六品圆满的顶尖高手。
若是能够得到天水精华，说不定可以凭借奇宝之力，冲击五品之境，所以得知此事以后，魏贤仁才这么着急忙慌地回到东宫，连太子府的产业也顾不得卖了。
至于卖掉的产业去了哪儿，基本上都进了魏贤仁的口袋，他已然是东宫最大的蛀虫之一。
一进入文华殿，魏贤仁就吩咐所有人出去，同时关紧殿门，迫不及待地朝着夏无恙看了过来：“太子殿下，龙虎大药就算了，咱家不需要，天水精华在哪儿，至少要分三分之二给咱家。”
他声音奸细，却不容置疑，丝毫没有拐弯抹角的意思，上来就要天水精华，连基本的礼数都没有，半点儿都没有把夏无恙放在眼中。
更不知道此时此刻的夏无恙，已经不是原来的夏无恙。
夏无恙浑浊的老眼微微眯起，点了点头，朝着练功室走去：“天水精华自然有魏公公一份，就在练功室中。”
“太子殿下果然懂事，咱家就喜欢跟随太子殿下。”魏贤仁喜笑颜开，并没有怀疑什么。
以前欺负惯了夏无恙，自然不觉得他敢做一些反抗之事，况且区区一个废人，就算再怎么反抗，又怎么是他这个六品圆满武者的对手。
满脸期待地跟着走进练功室，当玄铁大门关闭的瞬间，夏无恙骤然回头，一双眸子变得深邃如渊，定定地落在魏贤仁的眸子里。
“嗡……”
魏贤仁只觉脑中一震，眼前的景色天旋地转，竟是不知道身在何处，恍惚之间似乎来到了另一个世界。
那里是无间地狱！
在这方世界，被他欺负多年的老太子忍无可忍，给他服用了剧毒之物，并且只有老太子掌握着解毒之法。
他也曾想过尝试着解毒，却没有一次成功，反而因为剧毒发作，数天数夜生不如死，差点活生生地把自己给吃了。

经历了这些痛苦和绝望，魏贤仁对老太子再无半点儿不忠之心，不但将他知道的秘密全部说了出来，还发誓再不会背叛夏无恙分毫……
看着倒在地上昏迷不醒的魏贤仁，夏无恙瞳孔中精光闪动，通过小成之境的摄魂术，他轻松拿捏魏贤仁，将其控制过来。
从魏贤仁的记忆中，他赫然得知居然有那么多皇弟皇妹在关注着他的情况，魏贤仁也通过出卖他的情报和资料，换取了不菲的资源和宝物。
因为想要招揽他的皇子皇女太多，这厮如今还在待价而沽，游走在各个皇子皇女之间，牟取不菲的利益。
果然人心不足蛇吞象，已经从东宫获得了那么多好处，居然还不满足，仍旧要出卖他。
幸运的是魏贤仁天赋资质有限，就算有大量的资源和宝物，也无法吸收太多，只能暂且存储起来，如今自然都便宜了夏无恙。
这些年太子府的产业都快要被他卖光了，全部换成了天材地宝、灵丹妙药和金银珠宝，虽然没有奇宝，却也有很多中高级丹药。
如今夏无恙已经踏入了中三品，刚好能够使用这些丹药。
“砰……”
盏茶功夫过后，魏贤仁猛然惊醒，目光落在夏无恙身上，忽然跪倒下去，额头重重地磕在青玉地砖上：“殿下饶命，之前都是老奴的错，还请殿下给老奴一条活路，以后老奴一切都听殿下的，殿下让老奴往东，老奴绝不会往西，殿下让老奴往南，老奴绝不敢往北，只求殿下能够及时赐予解药，老奴愿做殿下走狗。”
通过摄魂术，夏无恙让魏贤仁承受了比千刀万剐还要恐怖的极刑，并且将其归咎到剧毒上面，所以此刻在魏贤仁的记忆中，他已经中了无解的剧毒，只有夏无恙这里有解药。
解药的引子乃是夏无恙的气血，就算得到了同样的解药，也无法解除他身上的痛苦。
每隔半年时间，他都要服一次解药，否则的话就会在极度痛苦和绝望中凄惨死去。
夏无恙现在没有这样的剧毒，所以他给魏贤仁服用的只是普通的剧毒，等到后续找到了合适的剧毒，才会加紧对他的控制。
不过有着摄魂术辅助，以后时不时地加强一下，应该能够掌控好魏贤仁。
只要给他足够的时间，等他的修为实力提升上来，到时候就算杀了魏贤仁，也没有什么影响。
目前拿下魏贤仁，比杀了他更有用，无论是魏贤仁的那些资源和宝物，还是他所掌握的渠道，都是夏无恙所需要的。
通过魏贤仁，他还能够自己“出卖”自己，从那些皇弟皇妹那里牟取更多的好处，可谓是一举多得，自然不能轻易放弃。
确认了魏贤仁已经被摄魂术震慑，不敢再背叛以后，夏无恙这才给了他一枚解药，让他服用以后，回去将各种资源和宝物悄悄送过来，不要被任何人知道。
魏贤仁老老实实地听从，对于这种自私自利的小人，就应该用这种法子。

有了魏贤仁这个奴仆，后续夏无恙行事也会方便很多。
不过表面上，魏贤仁仍旧猖狂嚣张，对外言说太子殿下赐给他一些天水精华，帮助他提升修为境界。
但是事情的真相到底如何，大家也都心知肚明，很多暗谍和内奸纷纷传出消息。

content_en:
Wei Xianren was not Xia Wuchang's first palm eunuch, but the one who was assigned to him after he lost power after a game between all parties.
Greedy, narrow-minded, selfish, mediocre in talent... there is almost no redeeming feature. He has been bullying the old prince these years, even daring to steal the rare treasures given by Emperor Xia.
Arranging such a person to be the palm eunuch in the East Palace shows the tacit understanding of all the forces, and they clearly do not want Xia Wuhuang to have an easy time.
After being deposed, Xia Wuyang also did some excessive things in order to restore the foundation of cultivation and embark on the path of cultivation again.
Wei Xianren collected these things and used them to threaten Xia Wuyan, not only forcing him to hand over the power of the East Palace, but also to hand over many resources and treasures to Wei Xianren.
With the help of the resources and treasures of the East Palace, Wei Xianren was able to break through the shackles and advance to the third level in just a few decades, and is now a top master of the sixth level.
If he could get the essence of Tianshui, he might be able to use the power of the rare treasure to reach the fifth level. So after learning about this, Wei Xianren returned to the East Palace in such a hurry that he didn't even bother to sell the property of the Prince's Mansion.
As for where the sold properties went, it basically went into Wei Xianren's pocket. He was already one of the biggest worms in the East Palace.
As soon as he entered the Wenhua Hall, Wei Xianren ordered everyone to go out, and at the same time closed the door of the hall, he looked at Xia Wuxuan impatiently: "Your Highness, forget about the Dragon and Tiger Medicine, our family doesn't need it. Wherever the essence of Tianshui is, at least two-thirds should be given to our family."
His voice was spooky, but there was no doubt about it. He didn't mean to mince words at all. He asked for the essence of Tianshui when he came up. He didn't even have basic etiquette, and he didn't take Xia Wuhuang in his eyes at all.
Little did he know that Xia Wuchang at this moment was no longer the original Xia Wuchang.
Xia Wuyang's cloudy old eyes narrowed slightly, nodded, and walked towards the practice room: "Of course Eunuch Wei has a copy of the essence of Tianshui, which is in the practice room."
"His Royal Highness is indeed sensible. Our family likes to follow His Highness." Wei Xianren smiled happily and did not doubt anything.
Xia Wuyan was used to being bullied in the past, so naturally she didn't think he dared to do anything to resist. Moreover, even if he was a useless person, no matter how much he resisted, he would never be the opponent of a sixth-grade perfect warrior like him.
He walked into the practice room with anticipation. When the Xuantie door closed, Xia Wuchang suddenly turned around, his eyes became as deep as the abyss, and fell firmly on Wei Xianren's eyes.
"Buzz..."
Wei Xianren felt a jolt in his mind. The scenery in front of him was spinning. He didn't know where he was. He seemed to be in another world in a trance.
There is endless hell!
In this world, the old prince, who had been bullied by him for many years, couldn't bear it and gave him a highly poisonous substance, and only the old prince mastered the antidote.
He also thought about trying to detoxify, but he never succeeded. Instead, due to the severe poisoning, he felt worse than death for days and nights, and almost ate himself alive.
After experiencing all this pain and despair, Wei Xianren no longer felt any disloyalty to the old prince. Not only did he tell all the secrets he knew, he also vowed never to betray Xia Wuyang again...
Looking at the unconscious Wei Xianren lying on the ground, Xia Wuyan's pupils flashed with light. Through the soul-stirring technique of Xiaocheng Realm, he easily grasped Wei Xianren and controlled him.
From Wei Xianren's memory, he suddenly learned that there were so many royal brothers and sisters paying attention to his situation. Wei Xianren also sold out his intelligence and information in exchange for a lot of resources and treasures.
Because there are too many princes and princesses who want to recruit him, this guy is still waiting for a price, wandering among the princes and princesses, making huge profits.
Sure enough, people's hearts are not as good as snakes swallowing elephants. They have received so many benefits from the East Palace, but they are still not satisfied and still want to betray him.
Fortunately Wei XianrentianWith limited talents, even if he had a large amount of resources and treasures, he could not absorb too many and could only store them temporarily. Nowadays, Xia Wuyan was naturally cheaper.
In recent years, he has almost sold out all the properties in the Prince's Mansion, replacing them all with natural treasures, elixirs, and gold and silver jewelry. Although there are no rare treasures, there are also many medium and high-level elixirs.
Now that Xia Wuyang has entered the middle third level, he can just use these pills.
"Bang..."
After drinking tea, Wei Xianren suddenly woke up, his eyes fell on Xia Wuyan, and he suddenly knelt down and knocked his forehead heavily on the sapphire floor tiles: "Your Highness, spare your life. It was all my fault before. Please give me a life." The way to survive is that from now on I will obey His Highness in everything. Your Highness will tell me to go east, but I will never go west. Your Highness will tell me to go south, but I will never dare to go north. I just hope that Your Highness can give you the antidote in time. I am willing to be His Highness's lackey. "
Through the soul-obsessing technique, Xia Wuyang made Wei Xianren suffer a death penalty that was more terrifying than being cut to pieces by a thousand cuts, and blamed it on the poison. So at this moment, in Wei Xianren's memory, he had been poisoned by a poison that had no cure, and only Xia Wuchang had the antidote.
The primer of the antidote was Xia Wuxu's Qi and blood. Even if he got the same antidote, it would not relieve his pain.
He has to take the antidote every six months, otherwise he will die miserably in extreme pain and despair.
Xia Wuyang did not have such a poison now, so he only gave Wei Xianren ordinary poisons. Only when he found a suitable poison later would he tighten his control over him.
However, with the assistance of the soul-stirring technique, and strengthening it from time to time in the future, he should be able to control Wei Xianren well.
As long as you give him enough time and wait for his cultivation strength to improve, even if he kills Wei Xianren, it will have no impact.
At present, capturing Wei Xianren is more useful than killing him. Whether it is Wei Xianren's resources and treasures or the channels he has, Xia Wuyang needs them.
Through Wei Xianren, he was able to "sell" himself and gain more benefits from the emperor's younger brothers and sisters. It can be said that he achieved multiple things with one stone, and naturally he could not give up easily.
After confirming that Wei Xianren had been frightened by the Soul-Calling Technique and did not dare to betray him again, Xia Wuyang gave him an antidote and asked him to take it and then go back and quietly deliver various resources and treasures without anyone knowing.
Wei Xianren obeyed honestly. This method should be used for such a selfish villain.
With Wei Xianren as his slave, it will be much easier for Xia Wuyang to do things in the future.
However, on the surface, Wei Xianren was still arrogant, saying that His Highness the Crown Prince had given him some Tianshui essence to help him improve his cultivation level.
But everyone knows the truth of the matter, and many secret spies and traitors have spread the news.
